mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1600.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals reduced supply chain pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above 700000 signals increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decrease in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals a shift towards inflationary pressures, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 45% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5 signals a tight labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased wage pressures.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 22500 signals reduced aggregate demand, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 40% of instances when GDPC1 < 22500.
